sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A tighter, more punishing follow-up to Cairn — pulsing group damage plus an add phase that buffs the boss if left alone.

sections.heading: Add phase
bullets: Jade Soldiers spawn periodically — every one left alive gives the Overseer a stack of Empowered (+25% damage each). Kill them fast, don't let them pile up.

sections.heading: Breakbar & ground damage
bullets: His defiance bar is segmented — breaking it stuns him and opens a damage window, so save burst for that.
Punishment pulses magic damage to everyone every 3 seconds throughout the fight — this is a steady healing/sustain check, not a one-off dodge.
The arena floor has claimed tiles that deal damage while you're standing on them — keep moving, don't plant on a bad tile.
